Welcome

Press the clasp to open the book
Welcome to Starcora · 1

Far, far away, past the moon and the stars, there is a magical planet called Starcora. The sky is always lilac and pink, like the moment just before bedtime.

Shooting Stars

Catch the shooting stars

Shooting stars! Tap them to catch them. Can you catch six?

Whoosh!

You caught every shooting star!

Welcome to Starcora · 2

On Starcora grows the Moonmist… Spiral Trees twist up to the sky. Swirlbuds curl like sweets. Dotstools grow big and spotty, just right for sitting on. And lantern-blooms glow to light the way.

The Spiral Tree

Wind the vine

Put your finger on the vine. Wind it all the way up the Spiral Tree!

Up it goes!

The vine twisted all the way up to the sky.

Welcome to Starcora · 3

Deep in the Moonmist live three best friends: Sola, Oro and Rose. Each one has a special magic called a Beamdrop… Can you find whose is whose?

Whose Beamdrop?

Find whose is whose

Drag each Beamdrop into the right name.

Sla
ro
Rse

Perfect!

The sun is Sola’s, the moon is Oro’s, and the flower is Rose’s!

Welcome to Starcora · 4

This is Sola. “Hello! I’m Sola, and I’ve always got a plan!” She is clever and kind. Sola’s Beamdrop is the sun. It makes light, warms things up, and gives a burst of energy!

Sola’s Sun

Melt the frost

Drag Sola’s sun onto the frosty bud and hold it there to warm it up.

Hello, flower!

Drip, drip! The frost melted away, and the little flower opened up.

Welcome to Starcora · 5

This is Oro, a shiny golden robot. “Hi! I’m Oro! Ready for an adventure?” He’s always the first one ready to go! Oro’s Beamdrop is the moon. It cools things down, pulls things close, and makes things go still. But sometimes Oro runs out of wind, and someone has to turn his key!

Oro’s Moon

Stop the wobble

The stepping stones are wobbling! Tap each one to make it still.

All still!

Every stone went still, and Oro hopped all the way across.

Welcome to Starcora · 6

This is Rose. “Hello,” said Rose softly. “I’m Rose.” She’s as sweet as honey. Wherever she goes, buds open and the forest seems to smile. Rose’s Beamdrop is a flower. It makes things grow, mends what is broken, and opens what is closed.

Rose’s Flower

Mend the Dotstool

Oh no, the Dotstool has broken! Drag the pieces back together.

Good as new!

The cracks closed up, and the Dotstool was good as new. The forest seemed to smile.

Welcome to Starcora · 7

And this is their home, the Cova, inside a giant tree. It is warm and glowing and cosy. On the shelf sits the Cova Chest, waiting for treasures from every adventure.

The Cova Chest

Open the Cova Chest

Tap the Cova Chest to open it.

The Cova Chest was empty, ready for its very first treasure.

Then something floated past the window… A letter? For us?

Find out what’s in the letter in the next book!

The End
